quest.title: Legend of the Darknight Hero
quest.description: Recently, rumors about a certain Darknight Hero have been circulating around Mondstadt...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Mora x13850, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Ask Charles about the recent rumors

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: So you've got a taste for adventure too, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I must say, the patrons have been in a bit of a buzz lately.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Though the topic on everyone's lips is more of an urban legend than actual news.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Even minding my own business I still end up hearing all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh... It's not one of those scary urban legends, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If so, Paimon needs to take a deep breath first!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it's not a particularly scary story, no... At least, not for most people...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: It's the tale of... the Darknight Hero!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh!!!

choices.text: Paimon, he literally just said it's NOT a scary story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Did the bartender just say something?

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: You weren't even listening?

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Anyway, the Darknight Hero.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: It is said that he appears in the middle of the night to fight evil and uphold justice.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: But to be honest, I don't have much interest in such rumors.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Unless of course he can help take care of the more belligerent patrons after they've had a few too many...

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: I would happily take that as proof of his existence.

choices.text: Has anyone ever seen him?

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: I'm told that there have been a handful of sightings. But in the depths of night, no one can get a good look at him.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Perhaps that's why he only appears at night.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Nevertheless, the sightings confirm that the Darknight Hero is more than just a groundless rumor.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Any guy in the tavern could tell you that.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Hehe, anyway... That's more or less everything I know.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: If you want to know more, ask around in the plaza. Ah, I need to serve some customers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Darknight Hero"... seems like your standard cookie-cutter urban legend.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But just a little darker.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wonder who it could be. Once you're ready, let's head out to the <color=#00E1FFFF>plaza</color> and ask around!

choices.text: Why would he hide his identity?

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: I doubt anyone knows but him.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Maybe he enjoys being a man of mystery.

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: After all, it's a good way to get the ladies' attention.

choices.text: Argh!

response.speaker: Charles
response.text: Hey. Look, do you want to hear the story or not?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha— What did the bartender just say?

talks.objective: Ask the bystanders at the fountain plaza for information

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: You want to find out about the Darknight Hero?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Look no further. It's me! I am the Darknight Hero.

choices.text: You're kidding, right?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: *giggle* You're right, I'm not. I was joking.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh...

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Heh. Jokes aside, I do think that the Darknight Hero and I have one thing in common.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: It's... the way he sticks to his principles... coming out here night after night, fighting for justice, keeping Mondstadt safe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, so you're a nocturnal vigilante too?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: N—No, I just mean, he must be seriously rich.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why is that?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: People only start worrying about spiritual fulfillment once they have enough material wealth.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: It's the same in every hero story, isn't it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So... you just wanted to flaunt your wealth.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Heh. No, it's nothing like that. I just have too much time on my hands these days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Same difference, you are the boss of the Cat's Tail after all...

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Why don't you ask the guards at the <color=#00E1FFFF>city gate</color>?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: They do night shifts all the time, they must know something.

choices.text: Just as I thought — it was you all along!

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: ...I'm joking. Don't take everything so seriously.

talks.objective: Ask the guards around the city gate for information

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: You want to know about... him?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: In fact, I'm one of the few who has seen him with my own two eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! This is the guy we need to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... just who is the Darknight Hero?

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Whoa— S—Slow down, let me start from the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Well, I was patrolling one night, when suddenly I heard something. I rushed over to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: I saw a gang of suspicious-looking fellows who looked like they were up to no good.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: So I quickly hid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hid? You're supposed to be a guard!

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: That was when... he appeared.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: He was dressed in black from head to toe, perfectly hidden in the night.

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: The way he crept up on those bad guys, it must have felt like a living nightmare.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Lawrence
dialogues.text: Guess what I did next?

choices.text: Ran away?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: I wasn't the bad guy! Why would I need to run away?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: ...Still, I did leave the scene. I didn't want to be a nuisance to the Darknight Hero.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: ...So instead, I headed to the Knights of Favonius' residence.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You think the Darknight Hero might be one of the Knights?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Correct. I thought, "Surely someone with such a strong sense of justice and who voluntarily protects Mondstadt is exactly the kind of person you'd find in the Knights of Favonius."

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: *sigh* But it seems I was wrong.

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: I checked everywhere, and there were no signs of anyone having left the building.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you're saying whoever it is can't be from the Knights of Favonius after all?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Yes. But I just can't understand... Why would someone like that not want to join the Knights?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: I'm sure they would warmly welcome someone of his abilities.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the point you're trying to make is... You don't know who the Darknight Hero is either?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Hey, don't be like that! At least by talking to me you've ruled out a few more people...

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Anyway, try asking at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Flower Shop</color>. I heard a girl there's been talking about the time he rescued her.

choices.text: Became his sidekick?

response.speaker: Lawrence
response.text: Heh... I would probably have just gotten in the way as far as the Darknight Hero is concerned.

talks.objective: Ask the preoccupied girl for information

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: What's wrong with me...

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Why can't I get him out of my mind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, hello? We'd like to ask you about the Darknight Hero—

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: MY HERO! ...Oh, sorry! Just hearing his name gets me lost in thought... Hang on, how did you know who I was talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Is it that obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Oh no, what am I going to do...? If Master Diluc ever finds out—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's Diluc got to do with this?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: Ugh... Well, I guess I might as well spill the beans then.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: I used to think Diluc was the one for me.

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: But ever since the time I was rescued by the Darknight Hero... I—I just don't know anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowee, you saw the Darknight Hero? For real? What's he like?

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: It all happened so fast... I was so scared...

dialogues.speaker: Donna
dialogues.text: All I remember is seeing a flash of fire... but I felt safe. I only saw his silhouette but it felt so... familiar.

choices.text: A flash of fire... a Vision, perhaps?

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: Who knows? Now that you mention it, a Pyro Vision does seem like a good explanation.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: It lit up the whole area in an instant. I remember that very well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oookay then! Well, thanks for the intel Donna. See you around!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, based on what we know so far...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All we need to do is find a wealthy, Vision-wielding vigilante who is not one of the Knights.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Nope, still no idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we already asked so many people. Guess we got to see for ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's take a look around the city at nighttime — if we're lucky, we just might bump into him.

choices.text: Familiar? Could it be someone you know?

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: Hmm... That I really do not know.

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: Perhaps it was... fate?

response.speaker: Donna
response.text: You know? When you meet someone and it feels like... like you've known them your whole life?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: After managing to steer clear of the guards' patrol route... I never anticipated I'd run into you instead.

choices.text: The Darknight Hero! I knew it was you all along!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: "Darknight Hero..."? Sounds awfully derivative to me. Please tell me you didn't come up with that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How is this the first you've heard of the name? Every man and his dog in Mondstadt is yapping about the Darknight Hero!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I do not concern myself with idle chatter... Though, I suppose I may take the idleness of others as a sign that peace prevails.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huzzah! The Great Mystery of the Darknight Hero of Mondstadt... We solved it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now then, Mr. Darknight Hero—

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Please, stop calling me that. Seriously, it makes me uncomfortable.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, not surprised. It's the stupidest superhero name Paimon's ever heard. You should come up with something more original.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Emm... "Captain Pie..."

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Pie?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Pie?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Captain Pyro!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tell us Captain Pyro, what happened here today?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It was the Abyss Order.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Them again?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I don't know what the devil they're plotting this time. It seems they're performing some initial reconnaissance.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Considering that I've proven myself to be one step ahead of them on countless occasions, their persistence is... unusual.

choices.text: Have you been dealing with them alone the whole time?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I assume so, unless you're aware of any other "Darknight Heroes" around these parts.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: The Knights are, for the most part, an utterly incompetent bunch.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I cannot trust them to take this matter over.

choices.text: So this is a job for the mighty Diluc then.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: *sigh* That's not my point. I am not doing this to impress anyone.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Well, I hope this conversation has been of service to you — because I would like to ask for a favor in return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, what is it Master Diluc? Your wish is our command~

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: You must keep my identity a secret.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Above all, it is crucial that you <color=#00E1FFFF>do not let the Knights of Favonius know I am connected to any of this</color>.
*footsteps*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that sound? Yikes, have the Abyss Order sent backup already?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: They appear to just be small-timers. You should have no trouble dealing with them.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I cannot afford delays on account of a few lackeys. I shall have to let you take care of them.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Remember — don't tell a soul!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You're just gonna leave us like this!?

choices.text: It seems you have history with the Knights.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: What's past is past. I would prefer not to discuss it.

choices.text: Why don't you get the Knights of Favonius to help?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmph. Who would be helping whom is debatable.

choices.text: Diluc!? YOU are the Darknight Hero?

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Heard anything about a "Darknight Hero"?

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Darknight Hero? Doesn't ring a bell.

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Certainly not one of our customers, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Fresh fruit only at Quinn's Fruit!

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Heard anything about a "Darknight Hero"?

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Hmm... That name does seem to ring a bell...

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: But I can't seem to recall much more than simply having heard the name. Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Greetings. I thought I heard something, so I came to check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Did you see anything out of the ordinary?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope. Nuh-uh. Not here. Nothing. Zilch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Unless you're looking for the Darknight Hero, in which case—

choices.text: Shut it, Paimon!

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: The Darknight Hero? You saw him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, ahh... The Darknight Hero, is ahh... {M#him}{F#her}!

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: You! The hero who safeguards Mondstadt from the shadows! On behalf of the Knights of Favonius, I thank you for your service to this city!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh... it's nothing, really... you're too kind...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Wait a second... Aren't you the Traveler that just arrived in the city?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Rumors were circulating about the Darknight Hero long before you ever arrived here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Ah...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: ...Why would you lie to me about that?

choices.text: Well...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Hmm. Never mind, you don't seem like bad folks.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: But I do hope you will visit the Knights of Favonius soon, where we can discuss the Darknight Hero situation in more detail.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Some things are best not discussed in public.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Duty calls. I must be going. Stay safe, Traveler!

choices.text: Sorry...
Ahem! *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Heard anything about a "Darknight Hero"?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hero... Sounds impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: But unfortunately, I don't know any more than you do.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Fresh fruit only at Quinn's Fruit!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: What do you know of the "Darknight Hero"?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Darknight Hero? Definitely heard him mentioned, yep. Nothing specific though.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Do you have any information regarding the "Darknight Hero..."?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Huh? What's the Darknight Hero?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Is it a fairytale?

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: I haven't seen any "Darknight Hero" around here.

dialogues.speaker: Wagner
dialogues.text: I'll tell you what though, if he's purchasing his weapons from someplace else, he doesn't know what's good for him.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Darknight H— *achoo* Hero? Sorry, I've never heard of him.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: My health is poor, *cough* I don't go out at night.

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Norma
dialogues.text: Never heard of him. Sorry, maybe someone else knows something.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: I've heard the name... I think. I'm not sure. Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Eury
dialogues.text: Is that from a fairytale, or a novel or something?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I think I've heard customers talk about that.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But I don't tend to listen in on their conversations, so I'm afraid I know nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: You mean that maverick Mondstadt crime fighter who comes out after dark?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: The Adventurers' Guild Intelligence Department is investigating it, but they haven't come up with anything so far. You should keep asking around.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find out about the "Darknight Hero."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I haven't heard a thing... *sigh* I'm really out of the loop.
